testimonials.intro: The most meaningful feedback comes from real projects. This section can feature your clients’ reviews.
testimonials.quote: We knew what had been agreed and where the work stood. The result is exactly what we planned.
testimonials.caption: Example renovation review

items.quote: During the renovation, we found that a wall needed more work than expected. We received an explanation and an updated estimate first. The team continued only after we agreed. We appreciated that nothing was done without checking with us.

Our main priority was getting the kitchen details right. Before installation, we looked at samples in our own space and light. Two small adjustments remained at handover, and both were completed on time.

We could not visit the site every day, so progress photos after each stage were a big help. When we needed to decide on an entrance detail, we received two options with a clear explanation of the differences.

faq.title: Good to know before we begin.
faq.description: A few answers to help you prepare for the first conversation.
faq.contactTitle: Have a specific project in mind?
faq.contactText: Tell us about the planned work and we can discuss a possible scope.

items.question: How should I prepare for our first conversation?
items.answer: Briefly describe the planned work, location and preferred timing. Photos or plans can help, but are not necessary at the start.

items.question: What affects the estimate?
items.answer: The scope and cost depend on the type of work, the property's condition, materials and project details. We need to understand the scope before discussing specifics.

items.question: Can I commission only part of the work?
items.answer: We can discuss the scope individually and agree which tasks should be completed and how they fit with other stages.

items.question: Who chooses the materials?
items.answer: We discuss materials together, taking the project requirements, your preferences and available options into account.

items.question: How is the schedule agreed?
items.answer: We can set dates once we understand the scope and availability of materials and contractors. It is helpful to raise timing in the first conversation.

items.question: Do you work outside the city?
items.answer: It depends on the location and scope. Include the town or area in your message so we can discuss it.
